sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages and spell lists, read through WebSearch summaries only: the wiki host is not reachable from the build machine (the search summaries name the pages and quote their descriptions).
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by WebSearch (ja.wikipedia.org Black Clover article, manga-tantei.com character articles, pixiv encyclopedia, ja.namu.wiki spell list, bclover.jp character files): Japanese spell names and one-line effects, read through search summaries only.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs (the exact chapter or episode of most spells was not confirmed): see docs/magic/character_spells_gold.md.

spells.name: Cherry Blossom Magic: (blossoms thrown as a strike)
spells.note: Mode 0 of the Cherry Blossom book; shown because the engine never hides mode 0. Cherry Blossom Magic needs no grimoire for its simple uses (en wiki summary).

spells.name: Cherry Blossom Magic: a passage of blossom wind for allies
spells.note: The Korean wiki summary says he uses the blossom wind to create a passage for allies; the page is the mod's nearest, so the match is design.

spells.name: Cherry Blossom Magic: blossoms over the battlefield as a defence
spells.note: The English summary says he covers a battlefield with blossoms as a defensive tactic; the page is the mod's nearest, so the match is design.

spells.name: Cherry Blossom Magic: Clones of the Beautiful Me
spells.note: A grimoire spell (an advanced technique he still needs the grimoire for).

spells.name: Cherry Blossom Magic: Magic Cherry Blossom Blizzard
spells.note: A grimoire spell, with Clones of the Beautiful Me his two named advanced techniques.

planned.name: Beautifying Bloom, Dance of 100 Million Cherry Blossoms, Everlasting Sakura Grove, Blossom Blessing, Blossom Snare, Petal Fan, Razor Petal Stream
planned.note: Pages of the repo's Cherry Blossom book that the searches did not find for Kirsch; they stay in the basic Cherry Blossom book.

notes: His canon grimoire was bound to the Plant book; the series' magic is Cherry Blossom Magic and the book exists, so CanonBook.KIRSCH now names CHERRY_BLOSSOM (the one edit of an existing line; a Kirsch grimoire made before keeps its Canon tag and shows the whole Plant book). No new page.
